text: “core variable” ADSL column appear every consumer domain (ADVS, ADAE, etc.) predecessor column — example, SEX RACE subgroup analyses. Note: core (string: Req/Cond/Perm) records ADaM conformance level unrelated “core variable” propagation. two fields control propagation : is_core (Boolean, column-level ADSL) — marks column propagation consumer domains. usecore (Boolean, domain-level) — signals domain receive propagated columns. top-level YAML property consumer domain, set via list assignment rather update_column(). populate_core() reads flags adds marked ADSL columns consumer domain predecessor columns. bundled examples include fields, add demonstrate workflow: SEX RACE now appear ADAE predecessor columns sourced ADSL.

title: Manage CDISC ADaM Dataset Specifications in YAML Format
text: Clinical data scientists programming CDISC Analysis Data Model (ADaM) datasets need specifications human-readable machine-readable. specifications typically live Excel spreadsheets hard version-control, difficult validate, consumed automation tooling. mighty.metadata replaces workflow YAML files. package loads YAML specifications, validates JSON schema, provides pipe-friendly R interface inspecting modifying column, parameter, row definitions. works two levels: single ADaM domain (mighty_domain()) entire study (mighty_study()). mighty.metadata part mighty framework automated ADaM programming. built S7 S7schema robust validation modern OOP.
